issue.title: [Practice] Products CSV fails to load
issue.body:
This is an invented practice report for this assignment repository, drafted with Codex. It is not an upstream bug report.

### Environment
DuckDB 1.4.1 command-line client, Ubuntu 24.04, x86_64.

### Problem
Reading my local products CSV fails with a conversion error. I expected the query to return the records from the file.

### Exact query
```sql
SELECT * FROM read_csv('products.csv');
```
I used no additional CSV options. I have not included the CSV contents or the complete error message.
